sourceFacts.description: One tall torsion-balance apparatus: cylindrical transparent enclosure with elliptic lid and bottom, tall narrow tube rising from the lid, a top adjusting assembly with central pointed/knobbed spindle and an offset side knob/control. Small slanted lid port/plug on image left. Full enclosing apparatus silhouette is present.

Fine central suspension descends from the tube/lid toward the middle of a transverse rod. Printed B is by the suspension and A above the left part of the rod. Left/front rod endpoint is dark small sphere a. A separate dark sphere b lies slightly behind/above a, with a lid-connected support on the left. Right rod endpoint is an open circular counterweight c. a and b are distinct, c is not another charged test sphere inferred from its outline.

An elliptic/annular band crosses the enclosure at rod height and has small unnumbered graduation marks on the visible front portion. Source has no readable angle values, calibrated numerical scale, distance, force arrow, charge sign or operating sequence.
